name: macd_signal_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms running directional orders create persistent EMA divergence that is visible in MACD at any timescale. When the MACD histogram (EMA_24 minus EMA_72, net of its 18-bar EMA) accelerates for 3 consecutive 5-second bars — meaning the short-term momentum is compounding rather than plateauing — it signals the institutional order is mid-execution, not near completion. NIFTY's tight liquidity and high notional volume ensure this histogram acceleration reflects genuine cumulative order flow rather than noise. Adding VWAP directional confirmation means we trade only when the institutional momentum aligns with the dominant session benchmark, filtering signals where counter-flow will resist continuation.

indicators.name: ema_fast_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute EMA capturing immediate short-term momentum. Original used 12-min EMA (12 bars × 1min); compressed to 2 min because we hold 30-90s not 15-40 min. The fast EMA needs to react within 1-2 hold periods to generate meaningful histogram.

indicators.name: ema_slow_72
indicators.purpose: 6-minute EMA providing trend baseline. Original used 26-min EMA. Scaled to 6 min (not 26 × 12 = 312) because the context window for a 30-90s trade should be ~4x the hold, not 20x. 6 min captures the institutional order's macro direction without excessive lag.

indicators.name: macd_signal_18
indicators.purpose: 1.5-minute EMA of MACD line. Original signal was 9 bars × 1min = 9 min. Compressed to 1.5 min consistent with our faster EMAs. Provides the smoothed baseline against which histogram is measured.

indicators.name: macd_hist
indicators.purpose: Histogram: difference between MACD line and signal line. The PRIMARY signal is its 3-bar acceleration pattern, not its level.

indicators.name: hist_accel_3bar
indicators.formula: hist[t] > hist[t-1] > hist[t-2] (bullish) OR hist[t] < hist[t-1] < hist[t-2] (bearish)
indicators.purpose: 3-bar monotone acceleration = 15 seconds of compounding EMA spread. At 5s resolution this matches the original's 3-bar filter at 1-min (=3 min). Filters single-bar spikes and confirms that the momentum change is sustained.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(sum(close * volume) / sum(volume)) from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP from 09:15. Cumulative measure — no scaling needed. Ensures longs trade above VWAP (institutional benchmark support) and shorts below (benchmark resistance).

indicators.name: vol_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling volume average. Weak filter to avoid stale/low-activity bars. Not a primary signal — index volume is noisier than single stocks but still a sanity check.

conditions: hist[t] > hist[t-1] > hist[t-2]  (3-bar histogram acceleration upward)
buy_ce.confirmation: 3 consecutive 5-second bars of increasing histogram — MACD spread widening faster, institutional buy flow accelerating mid-execution

conditions: hist[t] < hist[t-1] < hist[t-2]  (3-bar histogram acceleration downward)
buy_pe.confirmation: 3 consecutive 5-second bars of decreasing histogram — MACD spread widening to downside, institutional sell flow accelerating mid-execution

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts ≈ 8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5; if histogram acceleration triggers and then reverses within 30s (6 bars), a spot adverse move of this magnitude means the institutional order completed or reversed — the 3-bar acceleration thesis is wrong and we want out immediately. Calibrated to 30s typical NIFTY range of 2-5 pts.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts ≈ 14 NIFTY spot pts; institutional TWAP orders on NIFTY typically run 20-30 spot pt legs within their execution window. 14 pts captures ~50-60% of the expected 25-30 pt continuation, giving 1:1.75 R:R. Consistent with 60-90s NIFTY momentum move range of 5-10 option pts.

filters.vix_filter: none — strategy does not depend on VIX regime
filters.time_filter: 09:30–15:20 IST; first 15 minutes skipped to allow MACD EMAs to stabilize
filters.volume_filter: volume >= 0.8x 5-min SMA (soft sanity check, not primary gate)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction (long above VWAP, short below VWAP) and MACD line sign (long when EMA_24 > EMA_72)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices, spread is zero

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — MACD is widely watched, but histogram acceleration at 5s resolution is not commonly traded; algos targeting MACD signals may reduce edge over time if this pattern becomes crowded

adaptation_notes: Original was MACD(12,26,9) on 1-min bars of NIFTY 200 stocks, hold 15-40 min. Three key changes: (1) Timescale compressed: EMAs scaled to 2/6/1.5 min (not 12x blind which gives 312-bar slow EMA — absurd for a 90s hold). Rationale: for a 30-90s hold, context window should be 4-6x hold, not 20x. (2) Universe changed from stocks to NIFTY index: mechanism reframed around institutional TWAP flow rather than single-stock momentum. Index is smoother, more liquid, momentum driven by aggregate flows not earnings/news. (3) Volume filter softened (0.8x SMA, not 1.0x): index volume is noisier intraday than individual stocks; tight volume filter would eliminate too many valid signals. VWAP filter retained — same concept, same implementation (session VWAP), directly applicable to index.
weaknesses: MACD at 2/6 min EMAs on 5-second bars is still relatively fast — 15-second histogram acceleration (3 bars) can be triggered by single news spike rather than sustained flow
VWAP filter means no signals when price oscillates near VWAP — misses potential trades in a flat session
3-bar acceleration filter introduces 15-second entry lag — by the time signal fires on a fast NIFTY move, initial 5-8 pts may already be priced in
MACD histogram acceleration is a well-documented concept (Elder, Aspray) — institutional algos may generate false patterns

_source.original_stop: 0.25% from entry OR MACD line crosses signal
